bio: Founder @ASTBridge. Neuro-symbolic code migration agents turning legacy Java 7 & COBOL banking cores into verified Go microservices.
discovered_via: SEG-03: SEA Vertical AI & Agent Founders

recent_posts.text: Pure LLM code translation breaks on subtle fixed-point decimal rounding in core banking modules. By pairing tree-sitter AST control-flow invariants with property-based fuzzing in the agent loop, we hit 100% equivalence on 420k lines of legacy settlement code.
